name: omni-channel-platform
description: Unified platform for WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, LINE, WeChat integration

scripts.ngrok:kill: taskkill /F /IM ngrok.exe 2>nul || echo No ngrok processes to kill
scripts.ngrok:restart: npm run ngrok:kill && timeout 2 && npm run ngrok
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run backend" "npm run frontend" "npm run ngrok"
scripts.setup: npm install && cd omni-react-app && npm install
scripts.clean: taskkill /F /IM node.exe 2>nul || echo No node processes to kill
scripts.restart: npm run clean && npm run dev:all
scripts.status: echo Checking services... && echo Backend: && curl -s http://localhost:3000/api/health && echo Frontend: && curl -s http://localhost:5173
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run start

author: Omni-Channel Platform Team
